original.statement: The Loki Helm chart adds an extraContainers field to write pods, allowing operators to inject additional containers into write pod definitions.

corrected.statement: The Loki Helm chart offers write.extraContainers to add extra containers to the write pods. Only environments that set write.extraContainers use this option. Environments that leave it unset see no change.

decision.reason: [ev-25aeb771ff2f] describes only an optional new capability: extraContainers for the write pods. The artifact validator confirms that the key is write.extraContainers. It also finds no top-level extraContainers key in either release [ev-6b828f5bc194][ev-72c19aa86056], so the proposed path is wrong. The proposed 'unset' state would also flag every environment that does not use the option. Only environments that set write.extraContainers use the new option; for the rest nothing changes.
